description: This block allows to import IDDATA object from the MATLAB Workspace. The first output port of the block corresponds to the input signal of the IDDATA object and the second output port corresponds to the output signal. Specify a variable representing an IDDATA object corresponding to a single-experiment, time-domain data. Start time = -1 means that the start time for the signals in the IDDATA object matches that of the Simulink model. description: The Idmodel block accepts any of the linear identified models: state-space (idss), linear grey box (idgrey), polynomial (idpoly), transfer function (idtf) or process (idproc) models. Internally, models will be converted to their state-space equivalent for evaluation. Specify initial conditions as a numeric vector (idss, idgrey only) or as an initialCondition object.
